stories.title: CVE-2026-115995: A security vulnerability has been detected in Unitree Robotics Unitree Go2 up to 1.1.11.4. The impacted element is the function set_volume…
stories.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Unitree Robotics Unitree Go2 up to 1.1.11.4. The impacted element is the function set_volume of the file gpt_thread.py of the component chat_go. Such manipulation of the argument Value leads to os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. Upgrading to version 1.1.11.5 is sufficient to resolve this issue. You should upgrade the affected component. The vendor confirmed early: "Submission 990502 corresponds to our internal ticket #474 (Go2 chat_go set_volume OS command injection, CWE-78)."
actions: Skim it and note whether any client uses the vendor or product mentioned.
enrich_steps: CVE → EPSS + KEV + vendor advisory → which client assets run it (Shodan/Censys query filtered to country:GB)
IP → ASN and hosting provider (RIPE Stat), UK geolocation, AbuseIPDB reputation
